title: Tiny War Commander
description: Lead chibi blue squads, jeeps, and mini-tanks across tactical island battlefields to outnumber red garrisons and capture every enemy flag.
controls: Drag to lead your commander and squads across the battlefield, recruit reinforcements, and capture enemy strongholds.

zh-CN.title: 战场小指挥
zh-CN.description: 超上头微型玩具兵团对战：带领蓝色小兵、吉普车和迷你坦克冲锋占点，扩编军团一路推平红方堡垒！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动屏幕指挥小队走位、抢占资源点并召唤增援部队攻克敌方据点。
